page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

The underlying Intel Xeon processor supports several advanced instruction sets, including AVX, AVX512F, AVX512_VNNI, AVX512_BF16, and AES cryptography. In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates average single-core performance, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1571.88 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1308.0. Single-threaded tasks such as gzip compression and bzip3 decompression also perform in the average range, reaching 26.79 GB/sec and 10.33 GB/sec respectively.

However, multi-core and memory-bound performance metrics are relatively limited. The stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 2068.27 and Geekbench multi-core score of 1575.0 fall into the lower performance tier. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, with uncached read and write speeds of 15.65 GB/sec and 13.17 GB/sec respectively. Database operations and Redis SET performance are similarly positioned in the lower tier, with Redis handling 2.03 million operations per second.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and average single-core capabilities paired with modest multi-core and memory throughput, the ecs.hfg7.large is best suited for lightweight, single-threaded workloads, basic web serving, or development and testing environments that do not require high memory bandwidth or intensive parallel processing.
